# Ismail Anajar — Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Ismail Anajar, Full-Stack Developer from Casablanca, Morocco.
> Primary specialization: frontend (React, Next.js). Backend: Node.js, NestJS.

## Profile

Full-Stack Developer with 9+ years of experience building high-performance,
responsive, and maintainable web applications. Comfortable across the full
development lifecycle: requirements, frontend architecture, API integration,
backend development, performance optimization, testing, and deployment.

## Experience

- **Full-Stack Developer — Awnup** (Morocco, end-to-end product ownership):
  built the Awnup service marketplace end-to-end (frontend, backend,
  database/API layer, admin dashboard). Live: https://awnup.ma/fr
- **Frontend Developer — Astrovia** (web applications and digital products):
  e-commerce, loyalty programs, marketing platforms, internal business apps.
- **Full-Stack / Frontend Developer — Freelance**: web projects for small
  businesses (supermarkets, medical practices, pet businesses, e-commerce,
  marketing): requirements, architecture, development, API integration,
  database, testing, deployment, maintenance.

## Selected projects

- **Awnup — Service Marketplace**: production marketplace connecting customers
